subject: Social Media
title: Viral Shame Spirals
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Viral Shame Spirals.

hook.text: A teenager posts a dance video. It gets mocked. The mockery goes viral. She deletes her account.

buildup.text: Viral shame is uniquely cruel. Before the internet, embarrassment was local and temporary.

discovery.text: Online shame is permanent, searchable, and global. A moment of cringe follows you for years.

twist.text: The shamers forget quickly. The shamed person doesn't. Studies show viral shaming causes lasting trauma.

climax.text: Some victims changed their names. Others withdrew from public life entirely. Digital shame is exile.

punchline.text: The internet remembers what you wish it would forget.

quiz.question: What makes online shaming different from traditional embarrassment?
